lines: Shopkeeper. I am Sir Cedric Ashmore, Herald of the Crown.
By order of His Majesty, you are appointed Crown Supplier to the frontier settlements.
The corruption must be contained. Resources will follow your progress.
I will check in periodically. The Crown... takes an interest in your work.

dialogs.notes: Voice only. Brief, dismissive. Player may not realize this is significant.

lines: Well done, Shopkeeper. His Majesty is... pleased.
The Fungalmire to the east reports increased corruption. The spore-folk there are overwhelmed.
You are to establish supply lines in the region. The Crown provides.
Travel authorization and initial funds are enclosed. Make haste.
